Our Mission Patient outcomes at the heart Corcillum began with a simple but ambitious mission: to help prevent one million heart attacks by 2050. Every tool we build is designed to bring clearer insight to complex disease. By combining AI, high-performance computing, multi-modal imaging and secure data workflows, we help teams uncover patterns that traditional analysis can miss – supporting better research, faster discovery and more informed clinical decision-making. Radiology Cardiology Mission Prevent 1 million heart attacks by 2050 Purpose We believe in the power of technology as a force for good, unlocking better outcomes for patients Problem Cardiovascular disease is complex. The tools used to understand it often aren’t keeping up. Coronary disease is not always visible through anatomy alone. Pressure, blockage and structure can only tell part of the story. Researchers and clinicians experience time-consuming manual workflows, siloed systems, undetected disease, unnecessary procedures, and limited visibility into how disease may progress over time. Corcillum exists to close that gap – moving beyond static imaging towards richer, functional insight. Solution Beyond pressure. Beyond annotation. Beyond isolated systems. Corcillum brings advanced coronary analytics, AI-powered annotation and multi-physics modelling into a connected ecosystem. Our tools help teams curate medical imaging data, annotate rapidly, model physiology and explore disease progression with greater speed and clarity – all within a secure platform designed for research, innovation and future clinical applications. our services One ecosystem. Three connected capabilities. Innovative R&D Specialist coronary modelling expertise that helps research teams investigate disease mechanisms, test novel ideas and advance cardiovascular innovation with confidence. Data Curation & Processing A secure cloud platform for organising imaging datasets, streamlining annotation, managing quality control and preparing data for scalable analysis. Patient Diagnostics Emerging diagnostic tools designed to reveal hidden coronary risk, support functional assessment and enable more personalised clinical decision-making. Advanced scan analysis to diagnosis 10 mins Novel functional metrics 50+ OUR Mission: Heart attacks prevented by 2050 1 million Connected capabilities 3 Our technology Integrated cardiac intelligence platform for clearer, faster clinical insight From breakthrough research to faster clinical insight, Corcillum brings every part of the cardiac intelligence pipeline into focus – revealing what traditional imaging can’t always see, and helping teams move with greater clarity, speed and confidence. Explore platform Cardiology’s holy grail Corcillum helps teams move beyond pressure alone, providing richer functional insight into coronary disease and supporting research into non-obstructive plaque, disease progression and future cardiovascular events. Insights at full speed AI-assisted annotation and image processing reduce manual effort and help teams move from scan to analysis faster — improving research efficiency and reducing bottlenecks. Full pipeline partner From R&D and data systems to modelling and diagnostics, Corcillum supports the full innovation pathway rather than solving isolated parts of the workflow. The future of cardiac care With digital coronary twin technology, Corcillum enables patient-specific virtual models that can simulate blood flow, plaque progression and intervention scenarios for research and innovation. Secure from the ground up Corcillum is built on secure data foundations, with ISO/IEC 27001 certification and workflows designed for healthcare, research and enterprise environments. Local expertise, real support As an Australian-owned company, Corcillum offers local expertise, practical training and direct support from people who understand the pressures of research, healthcare and MedTech innovation. testimonials Prof Peter J Psaltis Interventional Cardiologist Royal Adelaide Hospital “We know A to F when it comes to coronary disease. Reject Accept Cardiology Cardiology clarity, beyond pressure. Corcillum helps cardiology researchers and clinicians see deeper into coronary disease. making the invisible visible $1 trillion annual projected global economic burden of cardiovascular disease by 2030. Capabilities Advancing cardiology insights and care True vs False Positives More insight. Fewer assumptions. Traditional coronary assessment can leave critical questions unanswered. Some patients undergo procedures that may not be necessary. Others may have disease that remains undetected until later. Corcillum supports a more complete research picture by integrating anatomical imaging with functional modelling, helping teams better understand the relationship between structure, flow, plaque behaviour and disease progression Non-obstructive Plaque Making hidden risk easier to investigate. Some of the most dangerous coronary plaques may not present as obvious obstructions. That makes non-obstructive disease difficult to detect, interpret and monitor through conventional approaches alone. Corcillum’s advanced coronary analytics and digital twin modelling help researchers investigate plaque behaviour, progression and risk in greater detail — supporting the search for earlier, more personalised intervention pathways. Beyond Pressure The full functional picture. Pressure is important, but it is only one part of coronary physiology. Corcillum gives teams access to richer functional insight by combining imaging, AI analytics and high-performance physics-based modelling. With over 50 novel functional metrics, researchers can explore disease progression, flow behaviour and intervention scenarios with a level of clarity not possible through pressure alone. Near Real-Time From scan to insight, faster. Manual analysis can take hours or days. Corcillum is designed to reduce the friction between image acquisition, annotation and analysis. With AI-assisted processing and streamlined workflows, teams can analyse imaging data faster, reduce bottlenecks and move more efficiently from research question to usable insight. Unique, Patented A new generation of coronary intelligence. Corcillum’s technology brings together patented AI, coronary physics simulations, cloud computing and multi-modal imaging integration to support high-fidelity digital coronary twins. These virtual models allow research teams to simulate blood flow, plaque progression and intervention outcomes — creating a more dynamic view of coronary disease and its potential future trajectory. Use cases Built for cardiology research, innovation and future diagnostics. Clinical research Study coronary disease progression, plaque behaviour and functional indicators with richer datasets and advanced modelling tools. Clinical trials Support imaging-based trials with structured annotation, data processing and reproducible workflows. Intervention planning research Simulate “what if” scenarios, intervention outcomes and device performance within a controlled digital environment. Corcillum helps radiology and research teams annotate, process and manage complex medical imaging datasets with greater speed, structure and confidence. making the invisible visible $1.2 billion spent on medical imaging research globally Capabilities Advancing radiology insights and care True vs False Positives Better data supports better interpretation. Corcillum helps teams create more consistent, structured and reproducible annotations, reducing manual variability and supporting clearer analysis across complex imaging datasets. Complex Imaging Data Bring order to complex datasets. Clarity Cloud supports multi-modal imaging integration, including DICOM and NIfTI, helping teams consolidate workflows and manage imaging data in one secure environment. Beyond Manual Annotation Faster annotation without sacrificing control. Corcillum’s AI-assisted annotation tools are designed to reduce repetitive manual effort while keeping expert oversight at the centre. Teams can use automated segmentation, contouring and labelling to accelerate workflows, while quality control processes support consistency, accuracy and research-grade outputs. Near Real-Time Keep research and trials moving. Time-intensive image analysis can slow research, delay trials and limit throughput. Corcillum helps teams process imaging data faster, collaborate more easily and prepare datasets for downstream analysis, AI training, validation and reporting. Unique, Patented AI, research and scalable imaging innovation. Corcillum brings together secure cloud infrastructure, AI-powered annotation, flexible workflows and custom processing to support radiology teams, research institutes, medical device companies, pharmaceutical organisations and AI developers. Whether you need to prepare labelled datasets, validate models or streamline imaging workflows, the platform can be adapted to your use case. Use cases Built for Radiology imaging teams working at scale. Radiology and research institutes Improve efficiency, precision and reproducibility in medical imaging workflows. Clinical trials Support structured, imaging-based trial workflows with secure data handling and high-quality annotation. AI developers Train and validate AI models with labelled datasets, quality-controlled annotations and scalable image processing. Medical device and pharmaceutical companies Support research, development and validation workflows with adaptable imaging infrastructure. Corcillum was founded with a simple, ambitious mission: to prevent one million heart attacks by the middle of the century. We believe technology can be a force for good in healthcare — helping researchers, clinicians and innovators see disease more clearly, understand risk earlier and develop better pathways for patient care. Values Innovation We push beyond conventional approaches to build tools that reveal new possibilities in medical imaging, modelling and cardiovascular research. Integrity We work with rigour, transparency and responsibility – especially when dealing with sensitive healthcare data and emerging medical technologies. Agility We move quickly, learn continuously and adapt to the changing needs of researchers, clinicians, partners and patients. Collaboration We believe better outcomes come from connected expertise. Our platform, partnerships and support model are built to help teams work together more effectively. Impact We measure progress by what it makes possible: better research, clearer insight, faster workflows and, ultimately, improved patient outcomes. Health Every innovation is anchored in the same purpose: supporting a healthier future through better understanding of disease. Corcillum is where human ingenuity meets the best of technology. Faster research workflows, richer imaging insights, more accurate modelling and better-informed treatment pathways are all part of the same ambition: a healthier future. Leadership team Led by science, engineering and lived experience. Harry Carpenter Co-Founder / CEO As a former Australian National Road Cyclist, Harry’s own cardiac experiences helped shape his passion for cardiac technology. After being diagnosed with supraventricular tachycardia, hospitalised with viral myocarditis and undergoing several cardiac surgeries, he went on to undertake a PhD developing novel physics-based simulations to identify dangerous plaques in heart arteries before they cause problems. Today, Harry brings together lived experience, research depth and MedTech ambition to lead Corcillum’s mission and clinical innovation pathway. Hugh Carpenter Co-founder / CTO With expertise in international finance, mathematics, computer science, software development, AI engineering and systems engineering, Hugh leads the technical architecture behind Corcillum’s platform. As CTO, he specialises in training the complex networks of algorithms that power corSUITE, bringing together AI, secure cloud infrastructure and scalable systems design. Board members Peter Psaltis a/prof, Non-Executive Director A distinguished researcher in cardiovascular medicine, Peter provides strategic direction in bridging AI with cutting-edge medical research. Lusia Guthrie Non-Executive Chair With decades of experience in biotech and AI innovation, Lusia plays a crucial role in shaping Corcillum's strategic direction. Geoff Thomas Non-Executive Director Geoff brings extensive expertise in business development and leadership, ensuring Corcillum’s vision aligns with global healthcare advancements. Darryl Carpenter Non-Executive Director With a strong background in governance and organizational strategy, Darryl helps steer Corcillum’s growth and regulatory compliance.
